sources.query:
SELECT day_of_week,
       ROUND(AVG(baseline_items), 1) AS baseline_items,
       COUNT(*)                      AS n_days
FROM   daily_trend
WHERE  day_of_week = 'Sunday'
  AND  date < '2026-10-04'
GROUP  BY day_of_week;
sources.note: daily_trend rolls the sales table up per day; baseline_items is the no-event trend for that weekday.
